basic_info.description: Live the Noe Valley dream in this luxurious 3bd/3ba bi-level condo with direct garage-to-unit elevator access just two blocks from vibrant 24th Street. Built in 2002, this meticulously maintained 1,806 SF (per graphic artist) home features indoor/outdoor living with an open floor plan connecting living, dining, and a chef's kitchen equipped with Wolf gas range, Viking refrigerator, and wine storage. The main level primary suite offers a gas fireplace and spa-like bath with marble counters, Fireclay tile steam shower, and heated floors. French doors lead to your private patio with outdoor kitchen featuring a sink and refrigerator. A second bedroom and full bath complete this level. Downstairs features a versatile third bedroom with full bath, gas fireplace, and stacked laundry, plus French doors to a shared patio. 1-car parking, shared yard with firepit, fountains and storage shed. Enjoy easy access to Noe Valley 24th St. shops and restaurants, parks, and transportation (J-Church, tech shuttles, 280 freeway).
